# Experiment summary

*Generated by `cnc_rl_demo.py`. Simulation results only: the process model is simplified and is not calibrated against a real machine.*

## Settings

- Algorithm: tabular Q-learning, 45 states, 27 actions
- Learning rate 0.15, discount factor 0.92, epsilon 1.0 decaying by 0.992 per episode to 0.04
- Training: 5000 episodes of up to 60 steps, seed 7
- Limits: vibration 1.0, temperature 105.0 C, tool wear 0.85

## Evaluation conditions

- 100 episodes on seeds 1000-1099, never used in training
- Every controller runs on the same seeds, so start state and noise sequence match
- Q-learning runs greedily (no exploration, no further learning)
- Fixed baseline (medium): 4500 rpm, 160 mm/min, 0.8 mm
- Best fixed setting: 3000 rpm, 160 mm/min, 0.8 mm, the best of all 27 constant settings on separate tuning seeds 5000-5049
